decisions.reason: As a still-uncertain but relatively low-cost digital option that could support closer customer collaboration and information security, we would keep it for another year despite its weaker fit with the core display business.
Because it builds on our core cardboard display capabilities and has already produced a strong market signal through the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, we would clearly keep it.

This product is close to our established offer and can be supported with existing production assets, so the option value of learning further still outweighs the limited cost of keeping it on the market.
A small counter display fits our narrow core range very well and is inexpensive to continue offering, so we would keep it while demand evidence continues to accumulate.

Although still close to our core business, the larger freestanding format likely ties up more production and logistics effort than smaller variants, so we would keep it but with a somewhat higher exit probability if traction stays unclear.
